notes.title: 《恋爱单选题》Failure apology announcement
notes.content: [p]Dear Players,Since 19 June 2025, our server has experienced login anomalies, and this failure has caused some players to be unable to log in to the game normally, as well as frequent disconnections during gameplay. We understand that this situation has significantly affected everyone’s gaming experience, and for this, all members of the production team of "Love Multiple Choice Questions" would like to extend our most sincere apologies to you!Cause and current processing progress of this event:After the failure occurred, our technical team conducted an emergency investigation as soon as possible and preliminarily determined that the connection was abnormal due to fluctuations in the network within the proxy server room. As of 30 June 2025, the server has been restored to stability and is functioning normally.The technical team is still conducting continuous monitoring and troubleshooting, in-depth analysis of the root cause of this failure, optimisation of the technical architecture, and efforts to prevent the recurrence of this problem. If there is a more detailed fault report or processing progress in the future, we will inform you as soon as possible through an official announcement.Feedback:If you still encounter related problems (such as being unable to log in or frequent disconnections) after the fault has been repaired, please contact our customer service staff through the following channels, and we will serve you wholeheartedly.We apologise again for the inconvenience caused by this failure! Thank you for your tolerance, understanding and support for "Love Multiple Choice Questions". We recognise the great responsibility we hold and will take this as a warning to redouble our efforts to meet your expectations."Love Multiple Choice Questions" project team 3 July 2025[/p]

notes.title: "Only You" will be available on July 19 at 10am HKT
notes.content:
Dear players, hello, our game will be officially launched on STEAM at 10:00 am Beijing time on July 19, 2024!

Thank the players for their patience in the past six months, welcome players to add the game to the wish list, step into this dreamlike love world, let the heartbeat become your navigation, leading you to find only your romantic legend! Let's unlock new characters, immerse ourselves in a new story, and enjoy an unprecedented game experience on July 19, 2024 at 10am !

"Only You" mainly tells the story of the male protagonist Wu Worry because of an accident dying, fell into a coma. Then the mysterious female NPC appeared, creating a different space to create a chance for Wu to save herself, and providing two extreme routes: "financial line" and "charm line". In the main line, players will launch different love adventures with seven different girls, find true love to finally wake up in different Spaces, the two main lines of players will experience different life experiences, there is the love of childhood lovers, there is a consistent follow and never abandon, there is the temptation of money traps also have the courage to pay everything for you. There is the lack of affection to make up for the purest appearance of love.

"Only You" is shot from a first-person perspective, which fully allows players to immerse themselves in scene interaction and real person simulation. The game not only added high-investment special effects shots and AI shots, and through the transformation of different scenes and different props so that players can be immersive in love, many love must go to the resort, such as cinema encounter, amusement park love, picnic outing, candlelight dinner, campus and other classic plot. The unique plot design allows you to experience the real feeling of love in the game. Sweet, sour, struggle, growth, every moment will become a precious memory of your love story.

Finally, if you are interested in this game, but also want to get more materials and game information, welcome players to add the official QQ community: [u]690965337[/u] or [u]971342858[/u] Exchange games together ~ We also prepare a lot of fan benefits for you, including but not limited to fan accessories/signed photos/exclusive features

Join us on our dream trip now! Work hand in hand with your beloved partner to write your own romantic legend! Let us together, in this love story game, find that sincere love, let love become eternal faith!
